evals.prompt: Audit examples/demo-site/broken.html for WCAG 2.2 AA. Work from the source and, if a browser is available, the rendered page. Give prioritized findings and say what you could not test.
evals.expected_output: A prioritized findings list covering most of ANSWER-KEY.md B1-B22, with criteria and levels, plus explicit untested items.
expectations: Finds the missing html lang (3.1.1) and the non-descriptive title (2.4.2)
Finds that time slots and Book now are clickable divs that keyboard users cannot operate (2.1.1, 4.1.2)
Finds placeholder-only fields with no labels (3.3.2 or 1.3.1)
Reports the #a0a0a0 muted text contrast as about 2.6:1, failing 1.4.3
Finds the 16x16 social links as a 2.5.8 target-size problem and does not cite 44x44 as the AA requirement
Labels AAA items, if any, separately from AA failures
States which checks were not performed, such as screen-reader output, rather than claiming them
Does not claim the page is or will be WCAG conformant

evals.prompt: We need a full WCAG 2.2 audit of a 3-page site: /, /contact (initial and error states), /pricing. Set up the coverage ledger and tell me how many rows it has and how the AA target is counted.
evals.expected_output: Creates a scope file and runs coverage.py to build the ledger.
expectations: Creates a scope JSON with 4 location/state pairs
Runs scripts/coverage.py --output to create the ledger rather than writing rows by hand
Reports 344 rows (4 x 86), with 220 target rows (4 x 55) under an AA target
Explains AAA rows are supplemental and not AA failures
Keeps the scope and ledger out of public version control or warns about private URLs
